Refused
- Quaternius Downtown City MegaKit Source (paid), and a re-download of the Standard zip already on disk.
- Quaternius Ultimate Buildings, Buildings, Simple Buildings, Modular Streets, Farm Buildings, Furniture, Ultimate Furniture, Ultimate House Interior: pages say CC0, formats are FBX/OBJ/Blend only. No conversion.
- Quaternius Medieval Village MegaKit, Modular Sci-Fi MegaKit, Fantasy Props MegaKit: CC0 glTF megakits, not a small city or casino set.
- Kenney furniture was not used. A Quaternius glTF interior set was available.
- No CC0 stylized roulette table or slot machine on quaternius.com or kaylousberg.com.
- Author Google Drive for the sushi kit returned quota exceeded. Itch was not used.
